claim: Email: "I looked at how Bussel Realty appears to someone searching for New Brunswick industrial space: the contact page returns a 404" and walk-in opener: "the contact page 404s".
problem: Contradicted for the context given. The New Brunswick contact page (bussel.com/contact-us/office-property/new-brunswick-nj) returns 200 with the broker directory; so does the site's own Contact Us menu target (bussel.com/contact-us.asp and /contact-us/commercial-real-estate/central-new-jersey). Only the bare /contact-us/ path 404s, and I found no page on the site that links to it. A founder checking the Contact menu will find a working page, which discredits the whole note.
fix: Name the exact URL and drop the generalisation: "bussel.com/contact-us/ returns a raw server error page" (or "the /contact-us/ address on your site throws an IIS error page"). Same for the opener.

claim: "Listings read '[-address on file-]'" (audit) and "listings hide the street address" (email, opener).
problem: Over-generalised from one listing. Listing #23253 and #27516 do print '[-address on file-]', but listing #26961 (an exclusive) prints a street address (Prestige Plaza, 334 Roue 31, Flemington). So "listings" tout court is wrong; a founder will check a listing that shows an address.
fix: Scope it: "open listings such as #27516 and #23253 print '[-address on file-]' instead of a street address; exclusives such as #26961 carry one." If the email keeps it, say "many listings".

claim: Section 1 agent scope: "fix the error and contact pages".
problem: Implies the contact page itself is broken. The contact pages work (200, directory + map); the fault is one orphan path plus no enquiry form, no tel: links and no structured data.
fix: Say "fix the orphan /contact-us/ path, add a branded 404, and give the working contact page an enquiry path".

claim: Founder note: "there is no New Brunswick office".
problem: Stated as fact but it is an inference from the absence of a published New Brunswick address. Strong inference, still an inference and unverifiable from outside.
fix: Hedge: "no New Brunswick address is published — the only office on the site is 2 Ethel Road, Suite 202A, Edison."

problem: Arithmetic is right, but the figure no longer matches the hand-off: analysis.json states "≈$5,000-$12,000/yr" for the same item, so two documents in the pack disagree.
fix: Use one number in both, and align analysis.json to the audit's $6,240–$12,480.

problem: The $30 rate (NJ secretaries median $24.16 × 1.25) is explained in section 2 but appears unexplained here, and it is the top of the loaded range implied by the posted $42,000–$50,000 (about $20–24/hour unloaded, ≈$25–30 loaded). Using the ceiling at both ends of an already illustrative range invites an inflation challenge.
fix: Add "(at the $30/hour loaded rate used above)" and note that a loaded $25/hour lower bound would put the low end near $13,000.
